newsitem.title: USA: Armco says weak shr cause unknown, sees gain.
newsitem.headline: Armco says weak shr cause unknown, sees gain.

text.p: Armco Inc said Tuesday that heavy trading driving its common stock to a new low of 3-3/4 was not related to any adverse developments.

The company said it expects third quarter net income from operations to be about $0.04 to $0.05 per share, in line with analysts' expectations. The company said additionally that it expects to report a one-time $0.06 per share gain for a tax settlement.
The company said it will report third quarter results October 22.
Armco said that the majority of the volume in recent days was a single block of 1.8 million shares traded on Friday, October 4.
